mutations.rationale: TypeScript src/internal/compression.ts compressPayload and Go go/codec.go CompressPayload make the size comparison strict, so a compressed payload whose marked size ties the escaped raw size is stored compressed instead of raw.

mutations.description: Write a tracked value for its full configured retention above the one-hour cap
mutations.rationale: TypeScript src/internal/redis-cache.ts RedisCache.putWithLayer writes a tracked value with its configured TTL instead of the smaller of that and MAX_TRACKED_REDIS_VALUE_TTL_MS, and Go go/engine.go putRemote skips the one-hour clamp (tracked_ttl_clamped) for a tracked write. A tracked value is therefore retained for its full configured retention, which its watermark, kept for twice the cap, need not outlive.

mutations.description: Release shadow capacity at the whole-job timeout before its raw work settles
mutations.rationale: TypeScript runShadowValidation calls release from the whole-job timeout hook and Go runShadow deletes the matching registration after awaitDeadline reports the timeout. Both free the slot while the raw source/read/decode/dump/write work still runs, allowing a competing job too early. The edits keep abandonment and late-result suppression unchanged.

mutations.description: Report a frame at its maximum age as an unclassified miss instead of expired
mutations.rationale: TypeScript src/internal/redis-cache.ts getWithResolvedConfig and Go go/engine.go readServing change the first maximum-age guard's miss diagnostic from expired to unclassified. Source fallback, refill authority and later reuse remain unchanged; the generated held-adapter history distinguishes the diagnostic at exactly 60000ms, before any source settlement.

mutations.description: Include process leaders in the reported follower count
mutations.rationale: TypeScript src/dialcache.ts getCoalescingState adds the registered leader count to activeProcessFollowers; Go go/bindings.go GetCoalescingState counts one extra follower per registered flight. The snapshot reports initiating callers as followers while caller outcomes and sharing remain unchanged.

mutations.description: Measure the oldest process leader age with the application wall clock
mutations.rationale: TypeScript src/dialcache.ts getCoalescingState uses Date.now instead of performance.now, while Go go/bindings.go GetCoalescingState uses Clock.WallMS instead of elapsedNow. Both subtract a monotonic registration instant from an unrelated application wall clock; the public snapshot changes under wall shifts.

mutations.description: Ignore the bounded shadow read result while the raw adapter operation remains pending
mutations.rationale: Both ports retain the read deadline and cancellation signal, but shadow validation waits for the raw result instead of consuming its bounded result. The C0 or C1 error therefore fails to appear at its own read deadline, while whole-job timeout and raw ownership continue independently.

mutations.description: Release shadow capacity at bounded read failure before the raw adapter operation settles
mutations.rationale: Both ports remove the shadow registration once validation has produced its bounded read error, omitting the additional raw read wait. A competing key is admitted before that raw read settles; the existing cancellation and error result remain intact.

mutations.description: Move an invalidation cutoff backwards when an older request arrives
mutations.rationale: Both ports change their production invalidation Lua at the same boundary: use only the new proposal instead of the maximum of the stored and proposed cutoff. The generated Redis cohort and exact vector boundary execute each changed script against a private real Redis server.

mutations.description: Reject the maximum supported invalidation buffer
mutations.rationale: Both ports change their production invalidation Lua at the same boundary: reject equality at the 31536000000ms maximum buffer. Client prevalidation remains unchanged; generated decimal inputs exercise the Lua itself. The generated Redis cohort and exact vector boundary execute each changed script against a private real Redis server.
